_comment: Source of truth. After editing run: pwsh -File tools/generate.ps1

f13._comment: F13-F15 have no physical key, so nothing else can collide with them.

f9._comment: Fallback if the Control Panel key picker has no F13-F24.

timing._comment: doubleTapMs: how long a tap waits for a second tap, and how long the rest of a tap burst is swallowed after a double fires. Windows' own double-click default is 500ms; a tight window here turns a slightly slow double tap into two single taps, which scaffolds the wrong project twice. holdMs: tap/hold threshold.

snip._comment: The overlay keeps its last-used mode, so a bare Win+Shift+S captures full screen once you set that mode by hand. forceMode drives the Alt+M menu on every press instead; that menu's layout varies between Snipping Tool builds.

buttons.label: Screenshot
buttons._modeNote: tapHold needs the chord held down while the button is held, so Auto-Release Outputs must be off for this mapping. If that can't be done, set mode to tapDouble and regenerate.
